Email is written in French (prospect is francophone)

expectations.evidence: Email references specific observed facts: 'ta page plugins WordPress est une reference', 'tu couvres les page builders, le SEO, la secu, les formulaires, le e-commerce... mais pas les LMS'. This is verifiable from the scrape.

expectations.text: Email contains none of the forbidden phrases (Je me permets, J'ai adore votre excellent, benefique pour votre SEO)

expectations.text: Output follows the exact format: Prospect, Analyse du prospect, Analyse de la page, Qualification, Email, Variantes d'objet (5), Relances (2), Anchors (5), Note strategique

expectations.text: Report saved as .md file in the outputs directory

suggestions.reason: Without-skill wrote an email even while recommending against sending — interesting difference. The with_skill version strictly refused, which is arguably better discipline.
Without-skill did deeper research (found real schoolsWP Tutor LMS pages, identified WPMarmite founder Alex Borto, YouTube 70K subs). More investigative but also more time-consuming (427s vs 206s).

eval_feedback.overall: Without-skill scored higher on assertions (5/8 vs 4/8) mainly because it wrote an email despite recommending against it — a mixed signal. Format compliance is clearly worse.
